lines.en: Fog-bound, step by step, danger abounds.
Fog conceals, true form hard to see.
Phantom-like, claw shadows hard to find.
Grim steps, through the mist.
Silent in the fog's embrace.
Fog Lion follows, relentless.
Fog swirls, silent pursuit.
Misty path, each step counts.
Fog like a dream, every step scary.
Fog within fog, steps hard to find.

lines.zh: 毛皮擦过灌木，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My fur rasps against the bushes.

lines.zh: 狮子般的低吟在雾里滚动。
lines.en: A lion-like growl rolls through the mist.
Silent watch, in the fog's embrace.
Fog's silence, waiting for prey.
Fog Lion stands still, patient.
Foggy calm, waiting for prey.
Fog's silent patience.
Foggy calm, waiting for the chance.
Fog's silent wait for prey.
Foggy calm, patient wait.
I lick my forepaws and comb my mane.
I doze on a stone slab.

lines.zh: 尾巴一下一下扫过苔藓。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the moss, stroke by stroke.
Ears up, my fur shivers in the wind.
I yawn, baring my fangs.

lines.zh: 雾气在鬃毛间凝成水珠。
lines.en: Mist beads into droplets in my mane.

lines.zh: 雾里那点金光是你的错。
lines.en: That gold gleam in the mist is your mistake.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把你从头到尾看一遍。
lines.en: I lower my head and look you over head to toe.
Staring at player, silent.
Sharp eyes, locking prey.
Glinting eyes, waiting.
Staring at player, waiting.
Sharp eyes, locking on.
Glinting eyes, waiting for the chance.
Staring at player, waiting for the chance.
My amber eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 鼻尖抽动，记下你的气味。
lines.en: My nose twitches, learning your scent.
I lower my head, shoulders tensing.
A low rumble rises in my throat.
My whiskers quiver, measuring the distance.
Half my head pushes out of the fog.
My pupils widen in the dark.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，堵住你的退路。
lines.en: I circle halfway and cut off your retreat.
My tongue slides over a fang as I watch you.

lines.zh: 雾皮被划开，血渗进毛里。
lines.en: My fog-pelt is sliced; blood seeps into the fur.
I'm injured!
My leg is hurt, can't run!

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的毛皮被划破了。
lines.en: A gash in my mistlion fur.
Hit by an arrow, hurts!
Foot wounded, can't walk!
Stomach wounded, feels bad!

lines.zh: 爪子受伤了，抓不了东西！
lines.en: Claws wounded, can't grab!
Hit by a knife, hurts!
Injured, can't move well!

lines.zh: 雾气缭绕，它缓缓靠近你。
lines.en: Mist swirls around as it approaches you.

lines.zh: 你感受到它冰冷的气息。
lines.en: You feel the cold breath on your skin.

lines.zh: 你手中的肉块让它驻足。
lines.en: The meat in your hand stops it in its tracks.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着阴森的光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a sinister light.

lines.zh: 它的身影在雾中若隐若现。
lines.en: Its form fades in and out in the mist.

lines.zh: 靠近它，你会感到毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Approaching it will send shivers down your spine.
It roars lowly, threatening you.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同深渊的呼唤。
lines.en: Its voice is a call from the abyss.

lines.zh: 你发现它是如此的渴望你的肉。
lines.en: You realize it yearns for your flesh.
It fixes you in its gaze, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰撞它的毛皮。
lines.en: Your shoulder collides with its fur.
You are pushed back by its strength.
It leaves marks on your body.

lines.zh: 它毛茸茸的爪子划过你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its fuzzy claws scratch your skin.
The impact of the seng is strong.

lines.zh: 它的攻击让人难以招架。
lines.en: Its attacks are hard to withstand.

lines.zh: 它的毛发摩擦着你的衣服。
lines.en: Its fur rubs against your clothes.

lines.zh: 碰撞中你感到一丝恐惧。
lines.en: A touch of fear accompanies the collision.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你难以动弹。
lines.en: Its strength leaves you immobilized.

lines.zh: 它的毛皮在碰撞中飞舞。
lines.en: Its fur flies in the collision.
It searches for the scent of its mate.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子嗅探周围的环境。
lines.en: It sniffs the surroundings with its nose.

lines.zh: 它发出寻找伴侣的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It hisses, seeking a mate.
Its call beckons its kind.
It approaches a potential mate.
It gently touches the other with its tentacles.
They entwine in the mist.
Its voice is filled with desire.
They leave marks together.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤在接触中发热。
lines.en: Its skin heats up with contact.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的毛皮，柔软而有光泽。
lines.en: Frosty's soft and glossy fur.

lines.zh: 这是一块雾隐狮的毛皮。
lines.en: A piece of Frosty's fur.

lines.zh: 生雾隐狮肉，闻起来很奇怪。
lines.en: Raw Frosty meat, it smells strange.

lines.zh: 我刚刚找到了雾隐狮的肉。
lines.en: I just found some Frosty meat.
Frosty's meat is very delicious.
Frosty's fur is quite valuable.

lines.zh: 我发现了一块雾隐狮的肉。
lines.en: I found some Frosty meat.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的毛皮适合做衣服。
lines.en: Frosty's fur makes great clothing.

lines.zh: 这正是我需要的雾隐狮毛皮。
lines.en: Here's the Frosty fur I needed.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的毛皮还带着体温。
lines.en: The seng's pelt is still warm.
Frosty is approaching.

lines.zh: 我发现了雾隐狮的踪迹。
lines.en: I've got Frosty's scent.
Frosty is closing in.
Frosty is stalking me.
I feel Frosty nearby.
Frosty is searching.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮正在追踪我的脚步。
lines.en: Frosty is tracking my steps.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮似乎在等待时机。
lines.en: Frosty is waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 我感觉雾隐狮在附近窥视。
lines.en: I feel Frosty watching.
Frosty is approaching silently.
A stranger's footsteps ride the wind.
I crouch low and melt into the mist.
A leaf ahead sways just once.
I smell iron and leather.
Prey has walked into my fog.
The tip of my tail goes stiff first.
Frosty is preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮张开了它的大嘴。
lines.en: Frosty's mouth is wide open.
Frosty is targeting me.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的双眼闪烁着绿光。
lines.en: Frosty's eyes glow green.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮准备用爪子攻击。
lines.en: Frosty is ready to strike.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的呼吸变得急促。
lines.en: Frosty's breathing quickens.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮已经锁定了我的位置。
lines.en: Frosty has locked onto my position.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的眼睛紧盯着我。
lines.en: Frosty's eyes are fixed on me.
Frosty is about to pounce.

lines.zh: 雾隐狮的獠牙露了出来。
lines.en: Frosty's fangs are showing.
My hind legs coil and swell.
Claws dig into the dirt, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 雾从我的鬃毛里渗出来。
lines.en: Fog seeps out through my mane.
My breathing slows; I will not back off.

lines.zh: 鬃毛竖起，我的身形变大。
lines.en: My mane bristles and I seem to grow.
I count the gaps between your blinks.
My fangs touch your shadow.

lines.zh: 扑击的弧线已在脑中画好。
lines.en: The arc of my pounce is already drawn.
Sharp claws slice the air!
Fogshadow stalks close behind!
Do you smell it? The mist's scent!
I am the avatar of death!
Consume your soul!
Watch out for the Fogshadow!
Fog's domain, my territory!
Use my fur to make a cloak!
Fog essence, nurture me!
A paw shoots out of the fog!
My teeth clamp onto your calf!
I swipe at your wrist!
I tear your armor open!
I pin you into the wet mud!
My tail sweeps your feet out!
A shoulder check knocks you over!
Appears silently in darkness!
Hunts in the deep woods!
Fog spirit calls me!
Fogshadow's shadow moves!
Fog's scent, guides me!

lines.zh: 我的爪子落上苔石，雾就散了。
lines.en: My paws touch the mossy stone, and the fog parts.
I seldom appear!
Fog's sanctuary, my home!
Fresh Fogshadow meat, delicious!
Wandering in fog, I am the spirit!
Two yellow eyes glow in the fog.
The brush bows as it takes shape.

lines.zh: 林间的湿气聚成一头狮。
lines.en: Forest damp gathers into a lion.
A hoarse lion roar sounds far off.
The fog parts and it steps out.
A lion's shadow falls on the mossy stone.

lines.zh: 它在雾里落足，无声无息。
lines.en: It pads through the mist without a sound.
The tall grass parts, mane first.
Burned by fire, so hot!
Fell down, hurts!
Drowned, so cold!
Explosion hurt, hurts!
Hit by a projectile, hurts!
Hit by magic, hurts!
Hunger hurts, so hungry!
Lightning hit, hurts!
Void, so cold!
